title: NNDC wallet cards 2023: 239Pu half-life 24109 y
summary: The October 2023 wallet-card row for 239Pu prints half-life 24109 y (year), uncertainty 15.
body: The October 2023 Nuclear Wallet Cards row for 239Pu prints half-life 24109 y (year). The uncertainty integer after the unit is 15. The decay-mode text before the gamma-ray energies is: SF. The booklet's half-life note says the value is followed by the unit (s: second, m: minute, h: hour, d: day, y: year) and that the uncertainty follows the unit and is given in italics. Superscripts in powers of ten were read from the smaller glyphs in the PDF. Italics were not a separate character. The uncertainty is the integer in that position. The booklet says all nuclides with T1/2 longer than 1 hour are included. This is an evaluated half-life from that compilation, not a new counting experiment.  A separate card, world.physics.239pu-half-life, quotes an IAEA Live Chart string for this nuclide. This card does not convert that string into the NNDC unit and does not declare the two strings equal.
